fields.name: CIC_Talk_Tracks
fields.fieldText:
Calls Quick Hits

  • Improved traffic sources
  • Percentage of calls lasting longer than 10 minutes has doubled in the last year
  • Lower pricing and more predictable volume
  • Returns up to 10% allowed


Talk Track

  • We have a new and improved version of our calls product that I am excited to tell you about. We have made a lot of investment in improving our Consumer Initiated Calls over the last 9 months and have seen some great results. 
  • We have improved traffic sources and are seeing increases in call quality. We use call duration as a way to judge quality since longer phone calls usually mean more meaningful consumer conversation. We’ve seen the percentage of calls that last longer than 10 minutes nearly double since this time last year with some of our larger agent customers having 50% of their calls going over that ten minute mark!
  • Another major upgrade- we are getting rid of the 2 minute qualifying window at the beginning of calls. This change will lower your overall pricing for calls and make it easier to predict what you need to pay to win volume in your area. Our auction weighs both the price you pay and the percentage of calls you bill to determine who wins volume. Now that all connected calls are billed, we can take that out of the equation and focus on pricing as the main lever to make sure you get volume.
  • Since we are removing the 2 minute qualifying window, we now allow you to return up to 10% of your calls each month for a calls return credit. You can submit call returns in Pro just like you would return a lead. At the beginning of each month we will review the returns for the prior month and apply a credit to your account. This return feature is only available on the new calls product and is not available if you keep calls with the qualifying window.

fields.name: Low_Close_Rate1
fields.fieldText:
Low Close Rate


Tactic 1: Offer to optimize the account by asking a question like “Have you spoken with anyone to optimize the account recently to Improve the quality of leads?”. If the agent says no, then offer to do an account review of what could be changed to help and pair these changes with a save credit based on best credit practices. This can be done by reviewing return reports and making recommendations on zip codes that can be removed to improve quality. You can pair this with a save credit to allow the agent to try these changes. Please refer to the credit best practices document. You can also review which leads types they have returned most and offer to make changes there as well.


Tactic 2: Pitch the LCS program to increase their close rate on leads.


Fallback: Offer to pause the account.

fields.name: Budget1
fields.fieldText:
Budget


Tactic 1: Dependent on the agent’s situation, ask discovery questions on their budget. “What does your monthly budget look like?” Make sure you’re calculating the cost of each lead and find the weekly cost and multiply by 4 to calculate monthly cost to make sure you are meeting their budget or right below it and change their volume cap as needed. 

﻿

Fallback: Offering to pause the account.

fields.name: Understaffed1
fields.fieldText:
Understaffed


Tactic 1: Pitch LCS. LCS can help an agent who is understaffed still work their leads and help them with the workload by only having truly interested consumers transferred over to their office. 


Tactic 2: Settings adjustments + Save credit. Ask discovery questions to find the agent's true cap. 

  • “How many leads can you take per day?” 
  • “Would adjusting your delivery hours help to limit which days you receive leads?”
  • Offer to turn down their volume cap so they get less leads while understaffed.
  • Make sure the agent knows they can utilize the pause button.
  • Offer to turn on the volume throttle based on the agent's needs.

Go over all of these options as a way the agent can manage their lead flow so their agency can still receive leads at their own pace.


Fallback: Offer to pause the account.

fields.name: Poor_Lead_Quality1
fields.fieldText:
Poor Lead Quality


Tactic 1: Offer to optimize the account and provide a save credit to try the changes.  Please refer to the credit best practices doc for save credit amounts. You can start by asking “Have you worked with anyone recently to optimize your account to improve lead quality?”. A question that may help you discover how to best help them can be- “What do your risk filters look like when working with consumers?”. This will help you make sure the agent's lead types match what they need from consumers to qualify for the agent to be able to work with them. 

You can optimize by pulling reports and seeing which zips they return the most from and make strategic changes to the agent’s zips codes.  The lead types they return the most of can also be taken into consideration and recommending a different lead type or change. 


Fallback: Offer to pause the account

fields.name: Infinite_Pause_Requests1
fields.fieldText:
Infinite Pause Requests


With this request you will want to ask the reason for the request for an infinite pause to determine which tactic would work best. We also want to make sure we are informing the agent that unfortunately infinite pausing is not an option, and we can’t delete all campaigns on the account as every account is required to have at least one campaign. 


Tactic 1: Decide based on information you find out from the agent as to why they are making this request. Use the save tactic you think would fit best based on the agent’s objection.


Fallback: Offer to pause. If the agent is on the fence, offering a check in appointment before the account becomes active can help. Also mention if you close the account, they will no longer be able to log in and view leads they recently purchased.

fields.name: Trying_Other_Vendors
fields.fieldText:
Trying Out Another Vendor


Tactic 1: You can always offer to change the agent’s settings to be the lowest they can be. Minimal hours and only 1 lead per day. This can be used as an example and what that looks like can be discussed further with the agent on what works for them. During this pitch let the agent know once the account is closed, they will no longer have access to view lead information of anything they recently purchased. 


﻿Fallback: Offer to pause while they try the other vendor. If the agent is on the fence offering a check in appt before the account becomes active can help.

fields.name: Lead_Pricing
fields.fieldText:
Lead Pricing


Review current pricing and what lead types they currently have.

﻿

Tactic 1: Consider if there are inexpensive options available. Ask the agent questions to see if they would be willing to change lead types to ones like preferred, standard, or non-standard. You can always pair this change with a save credit to try out a different lead type.


Tactic 2: Use the pricing tool and compare their current prices to recommended pricing. Go over the fallback pricing and see if it would be a good option to switch to. If not, we can always go to the floor pricing however always be sure to set the expectation that this may significantly decrease their volume, and they may not hit their volume cap daily.


Fallback: Offer to pause. If the agent is on the fence offering a check in appt before the account becomes active can help. Also mention if you close the account, they will no longer be able to log in and view leads they recently purchased.

fields.name: Contact_Rate1
fields.fieldText:
Contact Rate


Tactic 1: Review best practices for working leads. Ask the agent discovery questions such as:

  • “How often are you calling the leads?” “Do you also send consumers text messages or emails?”
  • Check to see if the agent has LCS. If they do ask “When are you calling the leads?”

After the agent responds, be sure to review best practices on working leads. If they have LCS be sure to touch on our recommended best practices on working leads in conjunction with LCS.


Tactic 2: Pitch LCS if the agent does not have it currently. Go over how LCS works and best practices of how to work in collaboration with LCS. Example: Explain we recommend not calling and working leads for the first 3 days and this is because we don’t want to overwhelm consumers. We have found this can cause issues getting consumers on the line.


Tactic 3: Pitch CIC. Consumer initiated calls would solve this issue for the agent because the consumer would be reaching out and seeking to speak with them for their insurance needs.


Fallback: Offer to pause the account.

fields.name: Lead_Type_Issues1
fields.fieldText:
Lead Type Issues


Tactic 1: Review current lead types and ask discovery questions such as: 

  • “What is your ideal consumer?”

The agent’s responses to this question will help you identify which lead type(s) best fits their needs.


Tactic 2: Go over with the agent how our questionnaire is self-reported. A way you can explain this is by saying:

  • “All of our leads here at EverQuote are consumer driven. Unfortunately, sometimes consumers can enter the incorrect information or sometimes be dishonest.”

﻿You can also let the agent know we do not have access to the same systems they do as an agent to see a consumer’s driving record. Encourage the agent to return any leads that are not meeting their filters.


Tactic 3: Review return rates and identify if there are trends, Locations (zip codes), times of day and lead types. For example, if they return mostly preferred leads- recommend removing that lead type along with zip codes with high return rates and offer a save credit to try these changes for a week or two.

fields.name: Volume_Troubleshooting1
fields.fieldText:
Low Fill Rate Cases/Volume Troubleshooting


  1. Pricing: The first thing to check is the agent's pricing. Use the current customer tab on recommended pricing tool to check the account. If they are below recommended pricing, encourage them to increase their pricing with volume boost.
  2. Settings Expansion: Check on the account settings. If there is opportunity to expand the agent's settings and cast a wider net to win more volume, encourage the agent to make those changes. Those changes could be:
    1. Adding more locations
    2. Adding additional lead types
    3. Expanding their delivery hours

fields.name: Lead_Quality
fields.fieldText:
Lead Quality Troubleshooting


Review the account settings and look for opportunities to optimize their account settings. Potential opportunities can include:

  • Ask "What do your risk filters look like when working with consumers?" This will help make sure that the lead types they are buying matches their target consumer.
  • Use the "Returns by Zipcode" Snowgoat report to see if there are zip codes that can be removed due to high returns
  • This list has the top zip codes in each state. If the agent is not targeting zips from this list, encourage them to add them in.
  • Use the "Returns by Lead Type" report to see if a certain lead type gets returned at a higher rate.

fields.name: Marketing_services_CS
fields.fieldText:
﻿State Farm Marketing Services Quick Hits:

  • ~10% bind rate
  • ~$120 CPB
  • Subscription fee waived through end of the year
  • ~$3500 budget = 30 policies



State Farm Marketing Services Pitch


  • We are thrilled to invite you to participate in our Marketing Services pilot program!


  • Our Marketing Services combine some of the best parts of data leads and paid search digital marketing to deliver you high-intent shoppers who are specifically looking to speak with a State Farm agent.


  • Here is how it works- we place State Farm branded ads on your behalf, interested shoppers can click on the ads and then will go through a qualification process. If the shopper is a good fit for State Farm they will be directed to your website and you will receive their contact information via ECRM so you and your team can reach out. The best part- you will only pay for the leads where the shopper is qualified!


  • Some numbers to help understand how compelling our offering is right now. These are promotional details through the end of the year as we want to help drive as many policies to you as we can and get our offering out in the market:
    • Bind rates are around 10%+
    • Cost per qualified lead comes out to about $12 for this promotional period - far less than market rates
    • If you are in the program with a budget of $3500 a month, you can expect around 30 policies in a month, which breaks down to a bind per day with an estimated cost per bind of $120!

As part of the Unified Lead Generation pilot launch, we are also waiving the subscription fee for State Farm customers through the end of the year. Now is the time to join the pilot program, take advantage of the low pricing, and see how Everquote’s marketing service can help grow your business!

fields.name: MS_support_process
fields.fieldText:
Marketing Services Support Process


How Accounts are Managed:

  • AGP Accounts utilizing marketing services are managed by their BC
  • Core/Starter customers are all currently managed by Naseef Sami


How to Field Requests

  • ﻿For any settings changes gather details of changes they would like to make
    • Budget changes get that amount
    • Zip exclusions get them to send you the list
    • Changes to what lines they want to target- what do they want to remove/add?
  • Pass request to appropriate account manager- If it is an AGP account pass to the BC, if it is Core/Starter pass to Naseef
    • SFDC has a field for Marketing Services- if box is checked, that customer is using the service
  • How changes are processed
    • Account manager posts in the #marketingservicescoordination channel and tags @marketingservicespointguard
    • They tag Ned- changes need to happen in both Enterprise Pro and in Round Robins that the SEM team maintains
    • Eventually we will have you all post changes to the #marketingservicescoordination channel directly

fields.name: calls_outreach
fields.fieldText:
Inbound Calls Issue Outreach Troubleshooting/Potential Solutions


  • Issue: Low mRate
    • Offer Returns Enabled Calls Product (no qualifying window, returns enabled)
    • Increase Bid to be Competitive using the recommended pricing tool
    • Advise How Missed Calls Impact mRate.
      • Missing calls can have a negative impact on your ability to get volume, so it is best practice to answer the phone or pause your account if you are not going to be available


  • Issue: Low Fill Rate
    • Offer Returns Enabled Calls Product (no qualifying window, returns enabled)
    • Increase Bid to be Competitive using the recommended pricing tool


  • Issue: BlockList
    • Discovery into their Process- are they following best practices for working calls?
      • Right Fit = Remove from Blocklist
      • Wrong Fit = Offer Different Product
    • Offer New Calls Product (no qualifying window, returns enabled)
    • Reach out in the #agency-inbound-calls channel to unblock accounts

fields.name: SFSubsidy2026
fields.fieldText:
Talk Tracks: 

  • The recent changes to State Farm's subsidy program may have altered your out-of-pocket lead costs. 
  • With the recent subsidy changes, we updated our billing logic to calculate your subsidy based on the discounted price you actually pay, not the list price. 
  • We adjusted discounts to maintain the same dollar value discount you received previously (e.g., if you received $4 off before, you still get $4 off).
  • While your dollar amount discount should be the same, you may be paying more (or less) for your leads because of the overall changes with the State Farm subsidy program.

Playbook for Unsatisfied Customers:

Some customers may be upset about the increase to their out-of-pocket cost and may request a bigger discount or to lower their volume cap. In those situations, we should use the following levers to overcome the customers objections:


  1. Discuss outcomes with our leads/cost per bind to help them understand it’s worth it to continue at the same price and volume. 
  2. If pushed, check the agent’s fill rate. If they have a high fill rate we could lower their volume boost amount or increase their discount.
  3. If lowering their lead cost will hurt their chances of getting volume- discuss other options for saving costs that don’t reduce volume cap. (ex: increasing preferred lead volume instead of Premium+ and Premium leads)

fields.name: AGP_Talk_tracks
fields.fieldText:
What makes a good AGP customer? 

  • Larger agency (at least 2 full time sales producers) 
  • Data driven
  • Tech enabled 
  • Willing to invest heavily in internet leads


Benefits of AGP 

  • Dedicated Business Consultant
    • More frequent check-ins compared to Core, including monthly account reviews
    • Deeper dives into account performance where your BC will use data and analytics to help identify additional opportunities for optimization
  • Monthly loyalty credits deposited on your account
    • Get up to 17.5% of your monthly spend credited back to your account
  • Priority access to new products and features- including enhanced targeting attributes only available to AGP customers


Sample AGP Pitch

Based on the size of your team and your focus on performance data, I think you would be a great fit for our Accelerated Growth Program. When you join AGP you get:

  • A business consultant to do more frequent account reviews to help improve performance using data and analytics
  • A monthly loyalty credit applied to your account 
  • Priority access to new products and features including some enhanced targeting attributes that are exclusive to AGP customers 
    • Home age for home leads, small business owner and multi-car for auto leads
